findings.title: Broken anchor #5-architectural-invariants in ADR-0001, ADR-0003, ADR-0010 pointing to ARCHITECTURE.md
findings.detail: Three accepted ADRs reference ARCHITECTURE.md via anchor '#5-architectural-invariants'. The actual section heading is '## 5. Architectural Invariants (explicit absences)' which generates anchor '#5-architectural-invariants-explicit-absences', making the ADR links dead. Fix requires either (a) editing ARCHITECTURE.md heading to remove '(explicit absences)' — but ARCHITECTURE.md is status:accepted, requiring ask-first — or (b) updating the ADRs — but those are also status:accepted and edits are hook-blocked. Carried forward unresolved.
findings.fix_sketch: Requires operator to either approve ARCHITECTURE.md heading simplification or accept the dead anchors as documentation debt.
